name: MillMess
summary:
It's a cold, cozy Christmas eve and everyone's asleep except for you! You're a good kid, but nobody will mind if you open a present earlier than you should...

MillMess is an original solitaire card game full of fun and bizarre creatures: THE RULES are simple yet chaotic, give it a look here (https://sites.google.com/view/mymadnessworks/home-page/millmess-rules) if you're confused (so that you can get even more confused). Or hey, you can always go in blind and join the mess!
